idea-plugin.name: Code Cat
idea-plugin.description:
Explore TypeScript, JavaScript, and Python projects through an AI conversation connected to source code and real debugger pauses.

Ask a question, follow a source location, then choose when to start debugging. Code Cat keeps observations and follow-up questions in one conversation. It distinguishes captured pause evidence from source-based inference.

This is an experimental preview tested with WebStorm 2025.1.3. The JetBrains host currently captures the paused location and nearby source, but not debugger variables or a complete call stack. Node.js 20+ and your own supported model API key are required. Model requests can include excerpts of project source code. See the privacy notice and setup guide.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First JetBrains preview: shared code-reading conversation, source navigation, streaming answers, and guided debugger pauses. Debug launch now checks the chosen entry against the breakpoint target.
